q.en: Why does a function taking int x fail to change the caller’s integer when it assigns x=9?
q.zh: 函数参数是 int x 时，为什么在函数内执行 x=9 不能改变调用者的整数？

a.en: The parameter is a separate object initialized from the argument value. Return the new value or pass a pointer to the caller’s object and modify that object through the pointer.
a.zh: 参数是一个独立对象，用实参的值初始化。可以返回新值，让调用者接收；也可以传入指向调用者对象的指针，再通过该指针修改那个对象。

q.en: Can a successful run prove signed overflow is safe?
q.zh: 成功运行能证明有符号溢出安全吗？

a.en: No. Undefined behavior is not made valid by one observed result. Guard before arithmetic.
a.zh: 不能。一次观察结果不能使未定义行为合法，应在算术前检查。

q.en: Why cast before division?
q.zh: 为什么除法前转换？

a.en: Converting the completed integer quotient cannot recover the discarded fraction.
a.zh: 转换已经完成的整数商无法恢复舍弃的小数。

q.en: What does sizeof count?
q.zh: sizeof 统计什么？

a.en: C bytes. CHAR_BIT states how many bits a byte has on the implementation.
a.zh: 统计 C 字节，CHAR_BIT 指明该实现每字节的位数。

q.en: Can a pointer one past a five-element array be used in a loop comparison?
q.zh: 指向五元素数组末尾之后一个位置的指针，可以用于循环比较吗？

a.en: Yes, it can serve as the end sentinel and be compared appropriately with pointers into the same array. Dereferencing that sentinel is invalid.
a.zh: 可以。它可以充当结束标记，并与同一数组内的指针进行符合规则的比较。但是不能解引用这个结束标记。

q.en: Does a pointer remember the array length?
q.zh: 指针记得数组长度吗？

a.en: Not by itself. Pass a length alongside the pointer or encode a valid boundary separately.
a.zh: 本身不会。应同时传长度，或另行表达有效边界。

q.en: Why is int ** not a two-dimensional array type?
q.zh: 为什么 int ** 不是二维数组类型？

a.en: It points to an int pointer object. A real grid converts to a pointer to an array row, with different layout and stepping.
a.zh: 它指向 int 指针对象。真实网格转换为行数组指针，布局与步长不同。

q.en: May an end pointer be read as an element?
q.zh: 结束指针可以作为元素读取吗？

a.en: No. It may mark the boundary, but dereferencing one past the array is invalid.
a.zh: 不可以。它能标记边界，但解引用数组尾后一位无效。

q.en: Why is char *p="lamp" different from char a[]="lamp"?
q.zh: char *p="lamp" 与 char a[]="lamp" 为什么不同？

a.en: p points to a string literal that must not be modified. a is a separate modifiable five-element array containing the four letters and the null terminator.
a.zh: p 指向不能修改的字符串字面量。a 是一个独立、可修改的五元素数组，里面有四个字母和一个空字符终止符。

q.en: Is strlen the buffer capacity?
q.zh: strlen 是缓冲区容量吗？

a.en: No. It counts bytes before the first terminator and requires that a valid terminator already exists.
a.zh: 不是。它数首个终止符前的字节，前提是已存在有效终止符。

q.en: Why reject 42x after strtol returns 42?
q.zh: strtol 返回 42 后为什么拒绝 42x？

a.en: The numeric prefix is valid but the suffix violates a strict whole-input integer contract.
a.zh: 数字前缀有效，但后缀违反严格整串整数契约。

q.en: Why cast char before isspace?
q.zh: 为什么 isspace 前转换 char？

a.en: A negative plain char other than EOF is outside the function’s permitted argument domain.
a.zh: 除 EOF 外的负 char 超出该函数允许实参范围。

q.en: If struct A contains int *data, what does b=a copy?
q.zh: 如果结构体 A 含有 int *data，b=a 复制了什么？

a.en: It copies the pointer value, so both structures initially refer to the same allocation. Independent ownership needs a deliberate deep copy or an explicitly shared-ownership policy.
a.zh: 它复制指针值，因此两个结构体起初都引用同一块分配空间。若要分别拥有独立数据，就需要明确的深复制；若要共享，则需要明确的共享归属规则。

q.en: Does structure assignment clone pointed-to objects?
q.zh: 结构体赋值会复制指针指向的对象吗？

a.en: No. Embedded arrays are copied, but pointer member values continue to designate the same objects.
a.zh: 不会。内嵌数组会复制，指针成员值仍指向同一对象。

q.en: Can memcmp generally test structure value equality?
q.zh: memcmp 能通用地判断结构体值相等吗？

a.en: No. Padding and representation details can differ. Compare the logical members explicitly.
a.zh: 不能。填充与表示细节可能不同，应明确比较逻辑成员。

q.en: Who keeps a union tag consistent?
q.zh: 谁保持联合体标签一致？

a.en: The program. An enum label alone does not automatically control which union member was initialized.
a.zh: 程序本身。枚举标签不会自动控制初始化了哪个联合体成员。

q.en: Why can a successful fprintf followed by a failing fclose matter?
q.zh: 为什么 fprintf 成功后，fclose 失败仍然值得重视？

a.en: Buffered output can defer the actual write. A later flush during fclose can fail, so the earlier formatted-write result alone does not prove all data reached the file.
a.zh: 缓冲输出可能推迟真正的写入。fclose 随后的刷新可能失败，因此先前格式化写入成功，并不能证明所有数据都已到达文件。

q.en: Why keep fgetc in int?
q.zh: 为什么用 int 接收 fgetc？

a.en: The result must represent every unsigned-char value plus the separate EOF indicator.
a.zh: 结果必须容纳全部 unsigned char 值及独立 EOF 指示。

q.en: Does a short read always mean an error?
q.zh: 短读总表示错误吗？

a.en: No. It can mean end of input. Inspect ferror and whether the format required more data.
a.zh: 不一定，也可能输入结束。要检查 ferror 及格式是否要求更多数据。

q.en: Why check close after successful writing?
q.zh: 写成功后为什么仍检查关闭？

a.en: Buffered output may fail only when it is flushed during close.
a.zh: 缓冲输出可能直到关闭期间刷新才失败。

q.en: Would fwrite(&record, sizeof record, 1, file) define the same portable format?
q.zh: 直接 fwrite(&record, sizeof record, 1, file) 能定义同样可移植的格式吗？

a.en: No. Object layout, padding and byte order may differ. Explicitly encode the fields required by the file contract.
a.zh: 不能。对象布局、填充和字节序都可能不同。应按文件约定显式编码字段。

q.en: Why is p=realloc(p,new_size) risky when new_size is nonzero?
q.zh: 当 new_size 非零时，为什么 p=realloc(p,new_size) 有风险？

a.en: On failure it overwrites the only saved allocation pointer with NULL, losing access to the still-allocated block. A temporary preserves the original owner until success is known.
a.zh: 失败时，它会用 NULL 覆盖唯一保存的分配地址，导致仍然存在的内存块无法访问。临时指针可以在确认成功之前保留原来的所有者指针。

q.en: Does free repair every alias?
q.zh: free 会修复全部别名吗？

a.en: No. Other stored pointers do not become safe merely because the owner was freed or set to NULL.
a.zh: 不会。所有者释放或设为 NULL，不会让其他保存指针变安全。

q.en: Why check multiplication before malloc?
q.zh: malloc 前为什么检查乘法？

a.en: A wrapped size can request too little storage even if allocation succeeds.
a.zh: 大小回绕可能请求过少存储，即使分配成功也危险。

q.en: What survives failed nonzero realloc?
q.zh: 非零大小 realloc 失败后保留什么？

a.en: The original allocation remains valid. Preserve its pointer in a separate owner variable.
a.zh: 原分配仍有效。应把其指针保存在独立所有者变量中。

q.en: Why must length change after reserve succeeds?
q.zh: 为什么必须在 reserve 成功后才增加 length？

a.en: Length promises that those elements exist and are initialized. Increasing it before a failed allocation would make the metadata promise data that was never stored.
a.zh: length 承诺对应元素存在且已初始化。若先增加它再分配失败，元数据就会声称存在实际上未存入的数据。

q.en: Why must deleting the head update the caller’s head variable?
q.zh: 为什么删除头节点时，必须更新调用者的 head 变量？

a.en: The old first node is no longer part of the list. Return the new head or pass a pointer to the head pointer; changing only a local copy leaves the caller pointing to the removed node.
a.zh: 旧的首节点已经不属于链表。应返回新 head，或传入 head 指针的地址。只改变函数中的局部副本，会让调用者仍然指向已移除的节点。

q.en: Why save next before free?
q.zh: free 前为什么保存 next？

a.en: After release, reading even the removed node’s link is invalid. Save every needed value first.
a.zh: 释放后读取被删节点链接也无效，应先保存所需值。

q.en: Is deletion by value constant time?
q.zh: 按值删除是常数时间吗？

a.en: Generally no. The search is linear even when the final link update is constant time.
a.zh: 通常不是。即使最后链接更新为常数时间，搜索仍为线性。

q.en: What must allocation failure preserve?
q.zh: 分配失败必须保留什么？

a.en: All existing reachable nodes and links must remain valid, with ownership still clear.
a.zh: 已有可达节点和链接必须仍有效，所有权仍清楚。

q.en: Why should a comparator return zero for values it considers equivalent?
q.zh: 为什么比较器应对它认为等价的值返回零？

a.en: The sorting algorithm relies on a consistent ordering relation. Contradictory answers can invalidate its assumptions and make the result meaningless.
a.zh: 排序算法依赖一致的顺序关系。前后矛盾的回答会破坏算法假设，使结果失去意义。

q.en: Can a cast fix an incompatible callback signature?
q.zh: 转换能修复不兼容回调签名吗？

a.en: No. Calling through an incompatible function type can be undefined behavior.
a.zh: 不能。通过不兼容函数类型调用可能产生未定义行为。

q.en: Why avoid a-b in an integer comparator?
q.zh: 整数比较器为什么避免 a-b？

a.en: The mathematical difference may overflow even when both inputs individually fit.
a.zh: 两个输入各自可表示，数学差仍可能溢出。

q.en: Why check a dispatch index first?
q.zh: 为什么先检查分派下标？

a.en: Accessing the table out of bounds is already invalid before any function call occurs.
a.zh: 调用函数前，越界访问表本身已经无效。

q.en: Why can parentheses fix BAD(a+1) but not SQUARE(i++)?
q.zh: 为什么括号能修复 BAD(a+1)，却不能修复 SQUARE(i++)？

a.en: Parentheses repair expression grouping. They do not turn duplicated tokens into one evaluated value or sequence the two increments.
a.zh: 括号修复表达式的分组，但不会把重复的记号变成只求值一次的值，也不会给两次自增安排先后顺序。

q.en: Do parentheses prevent duplicate evaluation?
q.zh: 括号能防止重复求值吗？

a.en: No. They control grouping, not how many copies of an argument are evaluated.
a.zh: 不能。括号控制分组，不控制实参副本的求值次数。

q.en: Is a macro with value zero undefined?
q.zh: 值为零的宏是未定义吗？

a.en: No. #ifdef sees a defined name; #if evaluates its numeric condition.
a.zh: 不是。#ifdef 检查名字已定义，#if 检查数值条件。

q.en: Why use static inline for small arithmetic?
q.zh: 小算术为什么使用 static inline？

a.en: It supplies type checking and evaluates each argument once inside the call; it is still subject to normal arithmetic limits.
a.zh: 它提供类型检查，调用中每个实参只求值一次，但仍受普通算术范围限制。

q.en: What does static on a file-scope helper function accomplish?
q.zh: 文件作用域的辅助函数前写 static，有什么作用？

a.en: It gives the name internal linkage, keeping that function’s identity within its translation unit. Another translation unit can use the same helper name for its own distinct function.
a.zh: 它让函数名具有内部链接，把函数的身份限定在本翻译单元内。另一个翻译单元可以用同样的辅助函数名，定义自己的另一个函数。

q.en: Does including a header supply every function body?
q.zh: 包含头文件会提供全部函数主体吗？

a.en: No. Headers normally provide interfaces; implementations must still be linked when required.
a.zh: 不会。头文件通常提供接口，所需实现仍必须链接。

q.en: Are scope and lifetime the same?
q.zh: 作用域与生命周期相同吗？

a.en: No. A local static object has block scope but retains its value throughout program execution.
a.zh: 不同。局部 static 对象具有块作用域，却在整个程序执行期间保留值。

q.en: What does file-scope static hide?
q.zh: 文件作用域 static 隐藏什么？

a.en: It gives the identifier internal linkage, distinct from same-named entities in other translation units.
a.zh: 它给予标识符内部链接，与其他翻译单元同名实体区分。

q.en: Why is a sleep call not a reliable substitute for waiting on a signal condition?
q.zh: 为什么 sleep 不能可靠地替代等待某个信号条件？

a.en: Sleep merely delays execution. It does not atomically coordinate the predicate check with signal delivery, and timing changes can expose the same missed-notification race.
a.zh: sleep 只是推迟执行，没有把条件检查与信号递送原子地协调起来。时序一变，同样的通知丢失竞争仍会出现。

q.en: Why avoid printf in a handler?
q.zh: 处理器中为什么避免 printf？

a.en: It may interrupt library state that is not safe to reenter. Record a permitted flag and print in ordinary flow.
a.zh: 它可能打断不可安全重入的库状态。应记录允许的标志，在普通流程打印。

q.en: Does volatile synchronize threads?
q.zh: volatile 会同步线程吗？

a.en: No. The signal flag pattern has specific rules; volatile is not a substitute for thread synchronization.
a.zh: 不会。信号标志模式有特定规则，volatile 不能替代线程同步。

q.en: Can a standard signal count every event?
q.zh: 普通信号能统计每个事件吗？

a.en: Not reliably. Repeated pending standard signals may coalesce; use an appropriate queued protocol for counts.
a.zh: 不能可靠保证。重复待决普通信号可能合并，计数应采用适当排队协议。

q.en: If a child changes a global variable, can the parent observe that change just by waiting for the child?
q.zh: 子进程改变一个全局变量后，父进程只要等待它结束，就能看到这个改变吗？

a.en: No. Waiting orders termination but does not merge separate ordinary memory. Use a pipe, shared mapping or another explicit IPC mechanism to communicate the result.
a.zh: 不能。等待只能协调终止的先后关系，不会合并彼此独立的普通内存。应通过管道、共享映射或其他显式进程间通信机制传回结果。

q.en: Does wait merge child memory into the parent?
q.zh: wait 会把子内存合并进父内存吗？

a.en: No. It reports child status and orders completion; explicit IPC is needed for shared results.
a.zh: 不会。它报告子状态并建立完成顺序，共享结果需要明确 IPC。

q.en: Why avoid printing process IDs in a fixed-output example?
q.zh: 固定输出示例为什么不打印进程号？

a.en: IDs depend on the operating-system run. Demonstrate roles and status without promising a particular identifier.
a.zh: 进程号取决于系统运行情况。应展示角色与状态，不承诺特定编号。

q.en: Why does a parent-only loop create linearly many children?
q.zh: 为什么只有父进程继续的循环创建线性数量子进程？

a.en: Each child exits before the next iteration, so only one process creates the next child.
a.zh: 每个子进程在下一轮前退出，所以只有一个进程继续创建子进程。

q.en: Why does calling exec in the shell process itself prevent that shell from returning to its old prompt?
q.zh: 为什么 shell 在自身进程里调用 exec 后，不能再回到原来的提示符？

a.en: On success exec replaces the shell’s program image. Fork first when the shell needs to preserve its own control flow while a child executes the command.
a.zh: exec 成功时会替换 shell 的程序映像。如果 shell 要在子进程执行命令的同时保留自己的控制流程，就要先 fork。

q.en: What executes after successful exec in the old image?
q.zh: exec 成功后旧映像的下一句执行什么？

a.en: Nothing. Success replaces that image; returning from exec indicates failure.
a.zh: 不执行。成功会替换映像；exec 返回表示失败。

q.en: Why test WIFEXITED first?
q.zh: 为什么先检查 WIFEXITED？

a.en: WEXITSTATUS is meaningful for normal exit, not every possible child termination status.
a.zh: WEXITSTATUS 只对正常退出有意义，不适用于所有子终止状态。

q.en: Does a zombie still execute application code?
q.zh: 僵尸进程仍执行应用代码吗？

a.en: No. It has terminated; its completion status remains until collected.
a.zh: 不执行。它已终止，只留下等待收集的完成状态。

q.en: Does a five-byte atomic pipe write guarantee the next read returns exactly five bytes?
q.zh: 一次五字节的原子管道写入，能保证下一次读取恰好返回五字节吗？

a.en: No. Atomicity protects that write against interleaving by other writers; it does not impose message boundaries on reads. A read may return fewer bytes or include bytes from multiple writes.
a.zh: 不能。原子性防止这一段写入与其他写者交错，不会为读取建立消息边界。一次读取可能少于五字节，也可能包含多次写入的数据。

q.en: When does an empty pipe return EOF?
q.zh: 空管道何时返回 EOF？

a.en: When every write endpoint is closed. A forgotten inherited writer can keep the reader waiting.
a.zh: 全部写端关闭时。遗忘的继承写端可能让读取者一直等待。

q.en: Does PIPE_BUF define a message boundary?
q.zh: PIPE_BUF 定义消息边界吗？

a.en: No. It concerns interleaving between writers, not how reads divide bytes.
a.zh: 不定义。它约束写入者之间交错，不决定读取如何划分字节。

q.en: Why drain output before waiting for a large writer?
q.zh: 大型写入者为什么应先排空输出再等待？

a.en: The child can block on a full pipe; waiting without draining can prevent the child from finishing.
a.zh: 子进程可能因管道已满而阻塞，不读取就等待会阻止它完成。

q.en: Why does one successful write not imply one matching read?
q.zh: 为什么一次成功的 write 不保证一次对应的 read？

a.en: The reader chooses a requested size, and a stream read may return fewer available bytes. Application framing and a loop reconstruct the intended message.
a.zh: 读取器自己指定请求大小，流读取也可能只返回当前可用的部分字节。需要由应用协议和循环重建完整消息。

q.en: Which mechanism naturally preserves individual records: a stream socket or a message queue?
q.zh: 流式套接字和消息队列中，哪一种天然保留每条记录的边界？

a.en: A message queue preserves message boundaries. A stream socket preserves ordered bytes, so record boundaries must be represented and reconstructed by the application.
a.zh: 消息队列保留消息边界。流式套接字保留有序字节，因此应用程序必须自己表示并重建记录边界。

q.en: Does message size include the leading long?
q.zh: 消息大小包含开头 long 吗？

a.en: For System V msgsnd and msgrcv, the size describes payload bytes after the type field.
a.zh: 对 System V msgsnd 和 msgrcv，大小描述类型字段之后的载荷字节。

q.en: Does a received byte array automatically form a string?
q.zh: 接收的字节数组自动成为字符串吗？

a.en: No. Use the returned length and add a terminator only within spare capacity.
a.zh: 不会。使用返回长度，只有容量有余量时才添加终止符。

q.en: Are local sockets network downloads?
q.zh: 本地套接字是网络下载吗？

a.en: No. AF_UNIX socket pairs communicate locally between endpoints created by this program.
a.zh: 不是。AF_UNIX 套接字对在本程序创建的本地端点之间通信。

q.en: Why can storing a raw pointer inside a shared-memory segment fail in another process?
q.zh: 为什么把原始指针放进共享内存段，另一个进程可能无法使用？

a.en: The second process may map the segment at a different address, and the pointee may not be shared at all. Store an offset from the mapping base or another explicitly portable reference.
a.zh: 另一个进程可能把共享段映射到不同地址，而且指针所指对象也可能根本不共享。应保存相对映射起点的偏移量，或另一种明确可用的引用。

q.en: Does sharing bytes protect an update?
q.zh: 共享字节会保护更新吗？

a.en: No. A separate ordering or synchronization protocol is still required.
a.zh: 不会。仍需独立顺序或同步协议。

q.en: What does successful sem_trywait consume?
q.zh: 成功 sem_trywait 消耗什么？

a.en: One available permit. With no permit, it reports EAGAIN instead of blocking.
a.zh: 一个可用许可。没有许可时报告 EAGAIN，而不阻塞。

q.en: Why store offsets instead of raw shared pointers?
q.zh: 为什么保存偏移而不是原始共享指针？

a.en: The same segment can be mapped at different addresses in different processes.
a.zh: 同一段在不同进程中可能映射到不同地址。

q.en: Can a worker safely return the address of a local int as its result?
q.zh: 工作线程可以安全地返回局部 int 的地址，作为结果吗？

a.en: No. That object’s lifetime ends when the worker returns. Use caller-owned storage that stays alive through the join, or a heap allocation with a clear ownership transfer.
a.zh: 不能。线程函数返回时，这个对象的生命周期已经结束。可以使用调用者提供且一直存活到 join 完成的存储空间，也可以使用堆分配，并明确转移归属。

q.en: May a worker begin before pthread_create returns?
q.zh: pthread_create 返回前工作线程可能开始吗？

a.en: Yes. Initialize arguments before creation and preserve them until all uses finish.
a.zh: 可能。创建前初始化参数，并保留到全部使用结束。

q.en: How are pthread errors reported?
q.zh: pthread 错误如何报告？

a.en: Most pthread operations return an error number directly rather than using minus one and errno.
a.zh: 多数 pthread 操作直接返回错误号，不采用负一加 errno 的方式。

q.en: Who frees a heap result returned by a worker?
q.zh: 谁释放工作线程返回的堆结果？

a.en: The program’s ownership contract decides. Here successful join transfers that responsibility to the joining thread.
a.zh: 由程序所有权契约决定。本例成功 join 后把该责任交给等待者。

q.en: If count is atomic, is if(count>0) count-- automatically one atomic transaction?
q.zh: 如果 count 是原子的，if(count>0) count-- 会自动成为一个原子事务吗？

a.en: No. The load and decrement are separate atomic operations, so another thread can act between them. Use a mutex or a correctly designed compare-exchange loop for the compound condition and update.
a.zh: 不会。读取和递减是两个独立原子操作，中间可以插入其他线程的操作。对于整个“检查再更新”，应使用互斥锁，或正确设计的比较交换循环。

q.en: Is a lost-update trace the only possible race result?
q.zh: 丢失更新跟踪是竞争的唯一可能结果吗？

a.en: No. The trace is an explanatory model. An actual C data race has undefined behavior.
a.zh: 不是。跟踪只是解释模型，真实 C 数据竞争具有未定义行为。

q.en: Why lock the check and update together?
q.zh: 为什么检查与更新一起加锁？

a.en: Another participant could invalidate the checked condition between separate critical sections.
a.zh: 另一参与者可能在分开的临界区之间使条件失效。

q.en: Does locking writers protect an unlocked reader?
q.zh: 给写入者加锁能保护未加锁读取者吗？

a.en: No. Every conflicting access must participate in an appropriate common synchronization discipline.
a.zh: 不能。全部冲突访问都必须遵循适当共同同步规则。

q.en: Why must a reader recheck state after releasing a read lock and acquiring a write lock?
q.zh: 为什么释放读锁、再取得写锁之后，还必须重新检查状态？

a.en: Another writer may have changed the state during the gap. The earlier observation is no longer sufficient to justify the intended update.
a.zh: 其他写者可能在间隙中改变了状态。之前的观察已经不足以证明当前更新仍然应该执行。

q.en: Does changing strtok to strtok_r fix shared buffers?
q.zh: 把 strtok 改成 strtok_r 能修复共享缓冲区吗？

a.en: No. Each concurrent parse still needs its own writable buffer and save pointer unless access is synchronized.
a.zh: 不能。并发解析仍需各自可写缓冲区及保存指针，或进行同步。

q.en: May a reader change data under a read lock?
q.zh: 读取者可在读锁下修改数据吗？

a.en: No. Concurrent readers rely on the promise that read access does not mutate the protected data.
a.zh: 不可以。并发读取者依赖读访问不修改受保护数据的承诺。

q.en: Why copy before unlocking?
q.zh: 为什么解锁前复制？

a.en: A writer may replace or release internal storage immediately after the lock is released.
a.zh: 解锁后写入者可能立即替换或释放内部存储。

q.en: Why must the producer be able to acquire the mutex while a consumer waits?
q.zh: 消费者等待时，为什么生产者必须能获得互斥锁？

a.en: The producer needs it to change the predicate. pthread_cond_wait releases the mutex atomically as it begins waiting, so the consumer does not block the work that can satisfy its condition.
a.zh: 生产者需要这把锁来改变条件。pthread_cond_wait 开始等待时会原子地释放锁，因此消费者不会挡住那个能让等待条件变真的工作。

q.en: Why use while instead of if?
q.zh: 为什么用 while 而不是 if？

a.en: A wakeup does not reserve data; the predicate can still be false when the mutex is reacquired.
a.zh: 唤醒不预留数据，重新获得锁时条件仍可能为假。

q.en: Where is the remembered work stored?
q.zh: 已完成工作的记忆存在哪里？

a.en: In the protected predicate and payload, not in the condition-variable signal.
a.zh: 在受保护条件与载荷中，不在条件变量信号中。

q.en: Why broadcast on shutdown?
q.zh: 关闭时为什么广播？

a.en: Several sleepers may need to observe the persistent closed flag and stop instead of waiting for future work.
a.zh: 多个睡眠者可能都需观察持久关闭标志，并停止等待未来工作。

q.en: Does consistent lock ordering prevent a thread from joining a worker that needs a lock the joining thread still holds?
q.zh: 统一锁顺序，能防止一个线程持有工作线程需要的锁，同时 join 该工作线程吗？

a.en: No. That dependency involves completion as well as lock acquisition. Release resources needed by the worker before joining, or redesign the protocol.
a.zh: 不能。这个依赖还涉及完成事件，不只是锁获取。在 join 之前释放工作线程需要的资源，或者重新设计协议。

q.en: Why not order unrelated object pointers with <?
q.zh: 为什么不用 < 排序无关对象指针？

a.en: C does not provide a general relational order for pointers to unrelated objects. Use explicit stable ranks.
a.zh: C 不提供无关对象指针的通用关系顺序，应使用明确稳定等级。

q.en: Does lock order guarantee fairness?
q.zh: 锁顺序保证公平吗？

a.en: No. It removes the targeted circular-wait pattern, not all starvation or scheduling problems.
a.zh: 不保证。它消除目标循环等待模式，不消除全部饥饿或调度问题。

q.en: When a second trylock fails, what happens to the first lock?
q.zh: 第二次 trylock 失败后，第一个锁怎么办？

a.en: The protocol must release it before abandoning or retrying the operation if retaining it would block progress.
a.zh: 若保留会阻碍进展，协议必须在放弃或重试前释放它。

q.en: Why can doubling cores stop improving a memory-intensive task?
q.zh: 为什么把核心数加倍，可能不再改善内存密集任务？

a.en: Workers can saturate shared memory bandwidth or contend for caches. The bottleneck is then data movement rather than available arithmetic execution units.
a.zh: 工作线程可能已经占满共享内存带宽，或在争用缓存。此时瓶颈是数据搬运，而不是可用于算术的执行单元数量。

q.en: Is an Amdahl number a benchmark result?
q.zh: Amdahl 数字是实测基准结果吗？

a.en: No. It is a model prediction under stated serial-fraction and perfect-parallelism assumptions.
a.zh: 不是。它是在指定串行比例与理想并行假设下的模型预测。

q.en: Why verify output before timing?
q.zh: 为什么计时前验证输出？

a.en: A program that skips work can appear fast while solving a different problem.
a.zh: 跳过工作的程序可能显得很快，却在解决另一问题。

q.en: Can CPU time replace elapsed time for speedup?
q.zh: CPU 时间能代替经过时间计算加速吗？

a.en: Not generally. Summed CPU consumption and end-to-end completion time answer different questions.
a.zh: 通常不能。累计 CPU 消耗与端到端完成时间回答不同问题。

q.en: Why is one shared increment per processed record often worse than per-thread local counts plus one reduction?
q.zh: 为什么每处理一条记录就递增共享计数器，往往不如各线程先局部计数再归约？

a.en: Every shared increment adds synchronization or cache-coherence traffic. Local counts keep independent work independent, and the final reduction performs far fewer shared operations.
a.zh: 每次共享递增都会增加同步或缓存一致性通信。局部计数让独立工作保持独立，最终归约只需少得多的共享操作。

q.en: Why join before computing block offsets?
q.zh: 计算块偏移前为什么汇合？

a.en: Offsets depend on completed earlier block totals. Reading unfinished results violates the dependency.
a.zh: 偏移依赖已完成的前块总量，读取未完成结果会违反依赖。

q.en: Why can output-row ownership avoid a matrix mutex?
q.zh: 输出行所有权为什么能避免矩阵互斥锁？

a.en: Each output element has one writer while inputs are read-only. The coordinator reads only after joins.
a.zh: 每个输出元素只有一个写入者，输入只读，协调者只在汇合后读取。

q.en: Is floating addition associative?
q.zh: 浮点加法满足结合律吗？

a.en: Not exactly. Changing reduction grouping can change rounding even without a race.
a.zh: 不严格满足。即使没有竞争，改变归约分组也可能改变舍入。

q.en: Why can adding printf make a race appear to disappear?
q.zh: 为什么加入 printf 后，竞争问题看起来可能消失？

a.en: It changes timing, scheduling and sometimes synchronization inside the library. That can hide a symptom while leaving the original shared-state protocol incorrect.
a.zh: 它改变了耗时和调度，有时还引入库内部的同步。这可能隐藏症状，但原来保护共享状态的协议仍然错误。

q.en: May a test expect a particular freed-memory value?
q.zh: 测试能期待某个已释放内存值吗？

a.en: No. Accessing an expired object cannot be assigned a portable expected result.
a.zh: 不能。访问已失效对象没有可移植期望结果。

q.en: Why inject failure instead of allocating an enormous block?
q.zh: 为什么注入失败而不是分配巨大块？

a.en: Injection is controlled and repeatable. An enormous request depends on environment and can disrupt the machine.
a.zh: 注入受控且可重复，巨大请求依赖环境，还可能干扰机器。

q.en: What should a rejected operation preserve?
q.zh: 被拒绝操作应保留什么？

a.en: Whatever its stated failure guarantee promises, such as ownership, length and existing contents. Check those facts explicitly.
a.zh: 保留其失败保证承诺的内容，例如所有权、长度与已有内容。应明确检查这些事实。

title.en: Observe defined wrap and guard signed addition
title.zh: 观察有定义回绕，保护有符号加法

intro.en: Use implementation limits without executing signed overflow.
intro.zh: 使用实现极限，不执行有符号溢出。

questions.output:
unsigned wrap=0
signed addition rejected
integer quotient=4
floating quotient=4.3333

en: Read the maximum from the header and add in unsigned arithmetic.
Reject signed addition before it crosses the bound.
zh: 从头文件读取最大值，并用无符号算术相加。
在有符号加法越界前拒绝。

title.en: Trace a prefix sum and a copied parameter
title.zh: 跟踪前缀和与复制形参

intro.en: Combine a loop invariant with one isolated function call.
intro.zh: 把循环不变式与独立函数调用联系起来。

questions.output:
processed=1 sum=2
processed=2 sum=6
processed=3 sum=13
returned=9
caller=5

en: Derive the element count at the array declaration site.
Print the preserved prefix invariant after every update.
Compare the returned value with the unchanged caller variable.
zh: 在数组声明所在位置推导元素数。
每次更新后打印前缀不变式。
比较返回值与未改变的调用者变量。

title.en: Start here: a copy and an address
title.zh: 从这里开始：副本与地址

intro.en: Follow one integer before learning array pointer arithmetic. Predict every printed value first.
intro.zh: 先跟踪一个整数，再学习数组的指针运算。先预测每一行输出。

questions.output:
inside copy=9
after value call: original=4 copy=4
after address call: original=9 copy=4

en: Create two independent int objects with the same initial value.
Pass a copied number; only the function parameter changes.
Pass a copied address; dereferencing reaches the caller’s original object.
zh: 创建两个初值相同、彼此独立的 int 对象。
传入数字副本，只改变函数自己的参数。
传入地址副本，解引用后访问调用者的原对象。

title.en: Traverse with a begin and end pointer
title.zh: 使用起止指针遍历

intro.en: Use the end as a sentinel, never as an element.
intro.zh: 把结束指针当哨兵，不当元素。

questions.output:
elements=3
sum=16

en: Create begin and one-past end from the same array.
Dereference only while the cursor differs from end.
Subtract same-array pointers to recover the traversed count.
zh: 从同一数组建立起点与尾后终点。
只在游标不同于终点时解引用。
用同数组指针相减得到遍历数量。

title.en: Use the actual row type
title.zh: 使用真实行类型

intro.en: Traverse a rectangular array through a pointer to a three-element row.
intro.zh: 通过三元素行的指针遍历矩形数组。

questions.output:
row 0 sum=12
row 1 sum=30
second row last=12
row elements=3

en: Declare the pointer with its row width.
Use separate row and column bounds.
Check row stepping and row length independently.
zh: 独立检查行步进与行长度。

title.en: Start here: a string needs an ending byte
title.zh: 从这里开始：字符串需要结束字节

intro.en: Look at a short character array before using a parser.
intro.zh: 先观察一个短字符数组，再使用解析器。

questions.output:
capacity=6 length=2
character 0=H
character 1=i
terminator is zero=yes
after edit=Ho

en: Separate the capacity six from the payload length two.
Inspect only the two characters and their in-bounds terminator.
Edit one character while preserving the terminator.
zh: 区分容量六和有效字符长度二。
只检查两个字符及范围内的结束符。
修改一个字符，同时保留结束符。

title.en: Return success separately from the result
title.zh: 把成功状态和结果分开返回

intro.en: Build a tiny parser with an explicit failure guarantee before reading strtol.
intro.zh: 在学习 strtol 之前，先构建一个明确约定失败行为的小解析器。

questions.output:
text='0' accepted=1 result=0
text='7' accepted=1 result=7
text='12' accepted=0 result=-1
text='' accepted=0 result=-1
text='x' accepted=0 result=-1

en: Write the accepted language first: one digit and then a terminator.
Run all guards before touching the output object.
Check both the success flag and the preserved value on rejected input.
zh: 先定义接受的格式：一个数字字符，后面紧跟结束符。
所有检查通过之前，不修改输出对象。
对于拒绝的输入，同时检查状态标志和保留的原值。

title.en: Separate text length from storage capacity
title.zh: 区分文本长度与存储容量

intro.en: Observe a terminated copy and explicitly detect a truncated formatted result.
intro.zh: 观察有终止符副本，并明确检测格式化结果截断。

questions.output:
text=Lamp length=4 capacity=5
stored=Map required=5
truncated=yes

en: Inspect the array size and the terminated text length.
Write through a bounded formatting function.
Check the returned required length against capacity.
zh: 查看数组大小与已终止文本长度。
使用有界格式化函数写入。
比较返回所需长度与容量。

title.en: Validate the entire integer input
title.zh: 验证整个整数输入

intro.en: Accept surrounding spaces while rejecting suffixes, empty text and range failures.
intro.zh: 接受周围空白，拒绝后缀、空文本及范围失败。

questions.output:
input 0 rejected
input 1 accepted=42
input 2 rejected
input 3 rejected

en: Reset errno and record the first unconsumed character.
Check both conversion range and destination type range.
Commit the output only when the entire text is accepted.
zh: 重置 errno，并记录首个未消费字符。
同时检查转换范围与目标类型范围。
整串文本接受后才提交输出。

title.en: Copy embedded data and share pointed-to data
title.zh: 复制内嵌数据，共享指向数据

intro.en: Compare two kinds of structure member after one assignment.
intro.zh: 一次赋值后比较两种结构体成员。

questions.output:
original label=oak value=9
copy label=Oak value=9

en: Create an embedded label and a pointer to shared data.
Copy the structure, then modify one member of each kind.
Compare which changes cross the copy boundary.
zh: 创建内嵌标签与共享数据指针。
复制结构体，再分别修改两类成员。
比较哪些修改跨越了复制边界。

title.en: Read a union through its tag
title.zh: 依据标签读取联合体

intro.en: Keep one tag and one initialized member in agreement.
intro.zh: 让一个标签与一个已初始化成员一致。

questions.output:
count=7
temperature=18.5

en: Initialize the count member together with its tag.
Select a member through a switch on the tag.
Change both representation and tag before reading again.
zh: 一起初始化计数成员及标签。
通过标签 switch 选择成员。
再次读取前同时改变表示与标签。

title.en: Read bytes until the operation reports the end
title.zh: 由读取操作报告结束

intro.en: Include a zero byte to show that file input is not a C-string traversal.
intro.zh: 包含零字节，说明文件输入不是 C 字符串遍历。

questions.output:
byte 0=65
byte 1=0
byte 2=66
count=3 ended=yes

en: Write a known three-byte sequence to an owned temporary stream.
Seek and read using the return value as the loop condition.
Distinguish a zero byte, end of input and an input error.
zh: 向自己拥有的临时流写入已知三字节序列。
定位后，用读取返回值作循环条件。
区分零字节、输入结束与输入错误。

title.en: Count bytes and complete records separately
title.zh: 分别统计字节与完整记录

intro.en: Read the same seven-byte input using two element sizes.
intro.zh: 用两种元素大小读取同一七字节输入。

questions.output:
complete records=0
received bytes=7
truncated record rejected

en: Rewind with a checked seek and request twelve one-byte elements.
Reject the input until all required record bytes exist.
zh: 请求一个完整十二字节记录。
用受检查定位回到开头，再请求十二个单字节元素。
所需记录字节未齐全时拒绝输入。

title.en: Define a file format instead of dumping a struct
title.zh: 定义文件格式，而不是直接写出结构体

intro.en: Mina saves a sensor value on one computer and reads it on another. A raw struct dump makes the file depend on padding and byte order. She replaces that hidden agreement with four explicit bytes: a tag, a version, a high byte and a low byte. She can now write down exactly what a reader should accept before she writes the file code.
intro.zh: 米娜在一台电脑保存传感器读数，再在另一台读取。直接写出结构体会让文件依赖填充和字节序。她改为四个明确定义的字节：标记、版本、高位字节、低位字节。这样在编写文件操作前，就能准确写出读取器应该接受什么。

questions.output:
wire: 76 1 2 1
decoded: 513
bad version and short record rejected; output unchanged

en: Define each byte. The numeric tag 0x4c is 76; version 1 selects the only supported layout.
Split 513 into high=2 and low=1. Decode with value = 256*high + low.
Check write, seek, read-error and close results. Reading up to five bytes also exposes an unexpected extra byte in this one-record format.
Validate size, tag and version before assigning the caller output. Invalid input preserves the previous output value.
zh: 定义每个字节。数值标记 0x4c 等于 76；版本 1 表示唯一支持的布局。
把 513 拆成高位 2、低位 1，再用 value=256×high+low 还原。
检查写入、定位、读取错误和关闭结果。单记录格式最多读五字节，还能发现多出的一个字节。
先校验长度、标记和版本，再给调用者的输出赋值；无效输入保留原输出。

title.en: Start here: one allocation, one owner, one release
title.zh: 从这里开始：一次分配，一个所有者，一次释放

intro.en: Follow a three-element allocation before adding resizing or linked structures.
intro.zh: 先跟踪三个元素的分配，再加入扩容或链式结构。

questions.output:
values=10,20,30
owner cleared=yes
releasing a null owner is allowed

en: Count elements and use sizeof the pointed-to type.
Check allocation before initializing or reading the elements.
Release through the owner and observe the cleared pointer without accessing freed data.
zh: 计算元素数量，使用指向类型的 sizeof。
初始化或读取元素之前，先检查分配成功。
通过所有者释放，只观察清空后的指针，不再访问已释放数据。
已分配，内容尚未初始化

title.en: Allocate, initialize, use and release
title.zh: 分配、初始化、使用与释放

intro.en: Check size arithmetic and allocation as two separate conditions.
intro.zh: 分别检查大小算术与分配结果。

questions.output:
count=6 sum=21
owner cleared

en: Validate the requested byte count without overflowing it.
Initialize every element before reading it.
Release the allocation and stop using its old addresses.
zh: 在不产生溢出的情况下验证请求字节数。
每个元素先初始化再读取。
释放分配，并停止使用旧地址。

title.en: Commit a resize only after success
title.zh: 调整成功后才提交新所有者

intro.en: Keep the old allocation reachable if a nonzero resize fails.
intro.zh: 非零调整失败时保持旧分配可访问。

en: Use a temporary result and commit ownership after success.
Initialize new elements and release the returned allocation base.
zh: 使用临时结果，成功后才提交所有权。
初始化新元素，再释放返回的分配基址。

title.en: Grow an owned array without losing it
title.zh: 安全扩容自己拥有的数组

intro.en: A sensor starts with two readings and keeps producing more. Mina allocates a larger array whenever space runs out. Her first sketch assigns realloc directly to the only pointer. If allocation fails, she can no longer find the old allocation. She rewrites the operation as a small transaction: check the requested size, ask for memory through a temporary pointer, and update the owner only after success.

title.zh: 汇合局部前缀后应用偏移

intro.en: Compute an inclusive prefix scan with two independent first-phase workers.
intro.zh: 用两个独立第一阶段工作线程计算包含当前位置的前缀和。

questions.output:
block totals=6 11
2 3 6 10 12 17

en: Assign one input and output block to each worker.
Accumulate earlier block totals as exclusive offsets.
zh: 给每个工作线程分配输入和输出块。
把之前块总量累计为不含当前块的偏移。

title.en: Give each matrix row one writer
title.zh: 让每个矩阵行只有一个写入者

intro.en: Read shared inputs and write separate output rows.
intro.zh: 读取共享输入，写入分离输出行。

en: Assign each output row to exactly one worker.
Join before any whole-matrix consumer reads the result.
zh: 保持两个输入矩阵只读。
把每个输出行分配给恰好一个工作线程。
任何完整矩阵使用者读取结果前先汇合。

title.en: Test the last payload byte and its terminator
title.zh: 测试最后载荷字节与终止符

intro.en: Preserve the destination when an input cannot fit.
intro.zh: 输入放不下时保留目的地。

questions.output:
length=0 accepted=1 stored=''
length=7 accepted=1 stored='1234567'
length=8 accepted=0 stored='kept'
length=11 accepted=0 stored='kept'

en: Reserve one byte before deciding whether the payload fits.
Exercise empty, last-valid and first-invalid lengths.
Check preserved destination contents after rejection.
zh: 判断载荷是否放得下前先预留一字节。
检查空、最后合法及第一个非法长度。
拒绝后检查目的地内容保持。

title.en: Inject allocation failure and verify preserved ownership
title.zh: 注入分配失败并验证所有权保留

intro.en: Run the same append path with a controlled failing resize and with real realloc.
intro.zh: 同一追加路径先用受控失败调整，再用真实 realloc。

questions.output:
injected accepted=0 length=2 capacity=2 values=4,7
real accepted=1 length=3 capacity=4 values=4,7,9

en: Introduce failure through a function matching the real allocator contract.
Inspect ownership-related state after the rejected append.
Run the successful path and release the final allocation.
zh: 通过匹配真实分配器契约的函数引入失败。
追加被拒绝后检查与所有权相关状态。
运行成功路径，并释放最终分配。
